results.message: What did the Punic-speaking people out in the countryside believe?

voice_event.speaker: lpc
voice_event.text:
We cannot say. Our whole record comes from two urban sees, and the voice speaking in it was taught in Latin. A different kind of life, spoken in a different tongue, lay between them, and we do not carry it in any detail. We will not invent it to fill the silence.

What we can say is what a bishop taught, what was given at the font, and what the road back looked like in our own cities. A bishop was given a people in one place. He preached to them and baptized them, and when they failed it was not a problem he managed but a wound he carried. You were taught before you were washed. We told you what you were joining before you joined it. Whether those same things reached a Punic-speaking congregation in the countryside in the same way, or in different words, or whether their own life took a shape our sources simply do not preserve -- that we do not know.
